notes.title: v0.18 Update
notes.notes:
Water Tank and Plastic Canister
Some POIs now feature a water tank. The tank contains between 20 and 90 units of clean water, which can be drunk directly or transferred to various water containers. The water respawns every 90 minutes. This addition is particularly interesting if you're starting a fresh game, as it reduces the hassle of making your own clean water early game.

Players can now find a plastic canister. It can hold 600 units of water and is therefore useful for transporting larger amounts of water.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/b830208979a10c4439b48d859393494feb062d0b.jpg

Fence Reinforcement
Players can now reinforce the wooden fence with an iron ingot for 120 additional hit points.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/bfbfe82cc1eeb16acc313817769d30101f5cbee7.jpg

Other Notable Changes

 added explanation pop-ups for the sleeping bag, totem and horde crystals 
 added sfx for recharging the flashlight with a battery
 increased spear throw force slightly
 plastic bottle now shows fill percentage when laying on the ground
 remaining ammo is shown for firearms hanging on the toolrack
 added tutorial task to place the campfire rack
 increased water barrel capacity from 1500 to 1800

Fixes

 door was stuck in old position when doorway was moved
 same screen resolution was shown multiple times in options menu
 max flashlight capacity was not applied correctly when game was reloaded


Have a great day!

notes.title: v0.16 Update
notes.notes:
Revised Planting System and Healing Herbs
All crops now use the same type of seeds. Players have a 40% chance of receiving a seed when harvesting plants growing in the forest. When harvesting a crop from the plant bed, players get the original seed back.

You can now grow healing herbs in plant beds. Harvesting the plant will heal the player to maximum health. There is a 3 minute cooldown between consuming healing herbs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/1a5c09e93cd8288bf22c36a404528fce22b295c5.jpg

Spikes Upgrade
Players can now upgrade spikes using one iron ingot. Upgraded spikes are dealing 50% more damage.

Due to a change in the structure upgrading system, existing reinforcements on foundations and walls are lost, but can easily be rebuilt!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/4bcc863ecf2e2a7e100712edfaf617794241206b.gif

Other Notable Changes

 daytime brightness was slightly increased
 max flashlight charge increased to 1 hour
 flashlight charge perk now increases max charge by 20 minutes per level
 added hint how to place sleeping bag
 added flashlight empty notification
 added wind sway effect to corn and cucumber plants
 starting loot is now found next to a tree


Have a great day!

notes.title: v0.15 Update
notes.notes:
Horde System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/61f8bd7aa057bb3784428a344854d1333da41f32.gif
The horde system has been reworked. Players now can place the totem to call horde waves. After defeating the horde players receive a perk point which can be used to unlock passive perks (e.g. more inventory slots). With each horde level the difficulty increases - players can remain at a specific horde level until they feel comfortable progressing. Night hordes are significantly weaker and adjust their strength to the current wave level on the totem. The amount of waves will be increased in the future, for now the totem supports 25 waves.

Players can now receive an immediate reward after defeating the night horde.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/c26c4e85c47e5e53d4ec33fce09c61f14294ac4a.jpg

Inventory Expansion
Players can unlock up to 4 additional inventory slots in the perk menu. The first 4 slots are now accessible with hotkeys 1 to 4. Items can now be moved in the inventory by drag and drop.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/45bf97790222a6efd582881edd3050605a369099.jpg

Mineral Extractor
Players can place the mineral extractor at certain drill site locations to automatically harvest ores. When powered with 5 power units, the mineral extractor can harvest two types of ores:

 iron ore (5 minutes per extraction)
 copper ore (8 minutes per extaction)

The mineral extractor can store up to 8 ores, after which it must be emptied to continue harvesting.

In order to harvest copper, the corresponding perk must be unlocked. Currently, copper can be used to craft electrical components, but will be necessary for structure upgrades in the future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/abf5b42fe3b7457e5915e4248da3ffd9826d8ade.jpg

notes.title: v0.14 Update
notes.notes:
Advanced Electricity
Players can now create more complex electric networks. When placing an electric structure it automatically connects to all electric nodes within range. If the total power consumption in a grid exceeds the total generation, the flow of electricity is interrupted. Players can restore the flow by switching off individual consumers or increasing the power generation.

[table]
    [tr]
        [th][/th]
        [th]energy generation[/th]
        [th][/th]

    [/tr]
    [tr]

        [td]defense turret[/td]

    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]solar panel[/td]
        [td]up to 6[/td]
        [td]interior & exterior light[/td]
        [td]1[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
Solar Panel
The solar panel is a new type of passive power generation. After construction, the solar panel must be mounted with two panels before it can start generating power. The efficiency of the solar panel varies with the time of day and reaches its maximum at midday. Solar panels can be found at outpost locations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/a1d1ee68f3871f61f617dc9945a2cee7d448de1d.jpg
Battery Rack
Players can store energy using a battery rack. Similar to the solar panel, the battery rack must first be mounted with car batteries before it can store energy. The energy capacity increases by 1000 per added car battery. Car batteries can be found at the new hut POI. Connected battery racks automatically charge and discharge according to the power grid requirements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/34e356e645a150d348981fee362b4fdfc2656a70.jpg
Fuse Box
Using the fuse box, players can get an insight into the current grid power generation, load and total stored energy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/2e9d0ab2d4448fd143052852c74cf90afc9e5b06.jpg
Power Relay
Players can use power relays to transmit electricity over greater distances.

Exterior Light
Exterior lights were added to illuminate the outside of your base.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/95ff48ffd8d884f0cb9bd96324471678b5431b14.jpg

New POI: Hut
The hut is located next to the lake in the northeast of the map. Here players can collect car batteries for energy storage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/a3f0d77be01846275926530eaff5bd6eca3f1c91.jpg

notes.title: v0.13 Update
notes.notes:
Wooden Housing Expansion
The appearance of all housing structures was reworked. Also new structures were added to further customize your base:

 interior light
 interior wall
 half wall

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/5a8301ba3af9fc9b4178ce9fa81f3eac27fb5df1.jpg
The structure upgrade system was reworked. Structures can now be upgraded directly by attaching metal sheets. They can be reinforced in several places, each reinforcement cost one iron ingot. When a structure is attacked, the reinforcements are first damaged before the actual structure is damaged.

NOTE: Due to the change in snap points, your housing structures may be offset. You can put them back in the right place by right-clicking and selecting "Move". Old versions of reinforced structures are removed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/37a8a6f23c7c57aa646b25ecfaeafe7b83541f44.jpg

notes.title: v0.12 Update
notes.notes:
Ambient Changes
The forest atomsphere has been adjusted to match the mystical setting of OddWoods. The forest will be darker at nighttime and having enough light at you base will be important when fighting the hordes. Work lights found around the map can be collected to illuminate your base. More light variations will be available in future updates. The large lake on the map was replaced by multiple smaller lakes.

Collectable stones, sticks and plants in the forest are highlighted as you approach them, as they are difficult to see in the dark.

The number of working lights found on the map was increased. You can continue playing on old saves, although a fresh start is required to collect the added working lights.

Two crystals appear on the map every morning. Players can locate them by markers and then destroy them with a metal pickaxe. Destroying both crystals before nightfall will weaken the incoming enemy horde. Enemies are only weakened in strength, but not in number.

notes.notes:
Explosive Trap
Like other structures, explosive traps can be placed via the building menu. Once construction is complete, players must fill the traps with two liters of gasoline. The traps are detonated by firearm projectiles or other close-range explosions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/1a6d9e883dbc8cb21cdfbaea36b4f933d427a121.gif

Expanded Difficulty Settings
Players can now choose between easy, normal, hard and custom difficulty mode. In the custom difficulty mode are the following settings:

 night horde enemy count
 night horde limit
 nutrition & water depletion rate

In easy, normal and hard mode, the night hordes are limited to day 25, after which the enemy count does not increase any further. Players can change or disable this limit in the custom settings.

Lookout Tower & Campsite

notes.title: v0.8 Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

NOTE: A FRESH NEW GAME will be required - no old saves.

Map Rework
This update interduces a map rework, featuring a 50% larger map with more variation in terrain and vegetation.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/a636588ef94fc4e1970daa0cb53241f00d51cdb9.jpg

New Motorcycle
The motorcycle will be spawned in a damaged state at a campsite. Players will need to find and repair the vehicle in order to use it.

 Repair cost: 4 vehicle parts

Once repaired the motorcycle will be marked on the map. If the motorcycle gets stuck, players can reset it to its original location by clicking "Reset motorcycle" from the pause menu.
The motorcycle needs fuel to run and can be refilled using a jerry can. Players can also store a jerry can on the back of the motorcycle.
In the event of a collision, the motorcycle will be damaged and may stop working. Players can repair it with vehicle parts. One vehicle part repairs the motorcycle for 50%.

Some were experiencing long save/load times due to garbage collection in the save file after each death. The next time you load the game as usual, the garbage will be removed automatically. However, if you are still experiencing a very long loading time, consider starting a new game. In addition, trees and bushes now respawn every two hours. Due to a change in the save system, all trees, bushes and rocks will be back when you load the save.

CHANGE - reduced wood foundation building cost from 4 logs and 5 planks to 2 logs and 5 planks
CHANGE - increased iron spear damage from 18 to 21
CHANGE - flashlight is now brighter

CHANGE - adjusted footstep sounds

FIX - enemies were playing wood hit sound when hitting the player
FIX - interaction keys can now be remapped in the settings
FIX - deer slid across the ground when the player approached it while it was grazing
FIX - plant beds can now only be harvested if there is enough inventory space

Kind regards
